# vix-call-1 results (generated by `research/lib/vixcall1.py`; do not edit)

Window 2006-03-31..2025-10-31 (4925 sessions), VXTH's sessions in insure-3's data. leg = VXTH's daily return minus the S&P 500 total return's. V1 = `tsmom12` (cash at bills) + leg; V2 = VXTH while trend is in, bills while out (2 bps a side); @x2 double leg; @cost50 V1 minus 0.50 pts a year; @cash0 trend's idle cash at 0. A1 = trend at exposure e (rest bills), A2 = w trend + (1 - w) PPUT (monthly), each set to V1's CAGR. Insurance cost = gap to hold (points a year) / mean loss avoided per fall (log points).
